offers_products.reason: Manufactures and exports ready-made sportswear and outerwear garments for global apparel brands.

offers_services.reason: Embroidery and custom cut-and-sew are part of manufacturing garments; the offering is mainly manufactured apparel, not separate services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to brands like The North Face, Adidas, Timberland, not directly to individual shoppers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are global apparel brands such as The North Face, New Balance, American Eagle, Calvin Klein.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat production orders from the same long-standing brand customers, though without subscription contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Apparel orders from brands can be cut when consumer demand weakens; apparel is discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Garments are produced in high volume and ordered frequently; individual units are low-priced.

people_delivered.reason: Product manufacturer of garments; customers pay for goods and factory capacity, not staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large global brands such as Adidas, The North Face (VF), Calvin Klein, and American Eagle.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates garment factories in Jordan with large production capacity, requiring ongoing investment in plants and equipment.

notes: Customer concentration is high among a few brands; recurring revenue is repeat orders, not contracts.
